title: Universal Life Insurance Computation Sheet: Full-Surrender Charge
content:
Computation of the full-surrender charge on an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy.

## Statement

1. **Effective date.** The surrender is effective on the date the signed surrender request was received: the received date of the owner's approved surrender request on the policy's service record.
2. **Policy year.** The policy year is counted from the issue date to that effective date. Policy year 1 runs from the issue date to the day before the first policy anniversary.
3. **Schedule rate.** The schedule rate is the tier's surrender charge schedule rate for the policy year in which the surrender is effective, in US dollars per $1000 of initial face (table below), and nothing once the tier's surrender charge years have ended: after 15 policy years on the Ashgrove Lifetime Guarantee UL and after 10 on every other tier.
4. **Charge.** The full-surrender charge is the initial face amount divided by one thousand times the schedule rate, rounded to the cent once at the end; no intermediate figure is rounded.

## Schedule rates (USD per $1000 of initial face)

| Policy year of the surrender | Lifetime Guarantee UL | Protection UL | Accumulation UL | Indexed UL Protect | Indexed UL Growth | Indexed UL Premier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 35.00 | 28.00 | 24.00 | 30.00 | 26.00 | 22.00 |
| 2 | 33.00 | 25.00 | 21.00 | 27.00 | 24.00 | 20.00 |
| 3 | 31.00 | 22.00 | 19.00 | 24.00 | 22.00 | 18.00 |
| 4 | 29.00 | 19.00 | 17.00 | 21.00 | 20.00 | 16.00 |
| 5 | 27.00 | 16.00 | 15.00 | 18.00 | 17.00 | 14.00 |
| 6 | 25.00 | 13.00 | 12.00 | 15.00 | 14.00 | 11.00 |
| 7 | 22.00 | 10.00 | 9.00 | 12.00 | 11.00 | 8.00 |
| 8 | 19.00 | 7.00 | 6.00 | 9.00 | 8.00 | 6.00 |
| 9 | 16.00 | 4.00 | 3.00 | 6.00 | 5.00 | 4.00 |
| 10 | 13.00 | 2.00 | 1.00 | 3.00 | 2.00 | 2.00 |
| 11 | 10.00 | nothing | nothing | nothing | nothing | nothing |
| 12 | 8.00 | nothing | nothing | nothing | nothing | nothing |
| 13 | 6.00 | nothing | nothing | nothing | nothing | nothing |
| 14 | 4.00 | nothing | nothing | nothing | nothing | nothing |
| 15 | 2.00 | nothing | nothing | nothing | nothing | nothing |
| 16 and later | nothing | nothing | nothing | nothing | nothing | nothing |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Tier | Initial face | Issue date | Surrender request received | Policy year | Rate | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove Protection UL | $400000.00 | 1 March 2019 | 15 September 2025 | 7 | 10.00 | 400 times 10.00, $4000.00 |
| Ashgrove Indexed UL Growth | $250000.00 | 20 May 2022 | 19 May 2023 | 1 | 26.00 | $6500.00 |
| Ashgrove Lifetime Guarantee UL | $500000.00 | 1 June 2011 | 2 June 2025 | 15 | 2.00 | $1000.00 |
| Ashgrove Accumulation UL | $150000.00 | 1 June 2014 | 2 June 2025 | 12 | nothing | $0.00 |
